messages:
marie: Heads-up — scheduling a maintenance change window for the Dedicated control-plane upgrade. Target: 2026-05-14 02:00-03:00 UTC. Drafting statuspage + customer email, asking for quick review and rollback checklist.

deploy-bot: Scheduled change window created: id cw-20260514-02. Notifies: #support, #eng-oncall, #eng-releases.

jonas: Thanks. Which service components are impacted? any DB migrations?

marie: Only control-plane API and model routing config. No DB migrations. Expected customer impact: soft degradation (higher tail-latency) for up to 10 minutes during canary, 0-2 min for remainder if canary is healthy.

sara: Draft statuspage blurb incoming. Suggest we call out Dedicated customers with reserved capacity and provide recommended action (pin to previous model) in case of rollback.

marie: Agreed. Draft statuspage snippet below — please suggest edits: 

```
Scheduled maintenance: Control-plane upgrade (Dedicated)
Start: 2026-05-14 02:00 UTC
ETA: 60 minutes (most customers unaffected; brief latency spikes possible)
What we're doing: Rolling upgrade to control-plane to improve routing and autoscale stability. No model data migration.
Customer impact: Short latency spikes for some requests; fallback to pinned model versions may be recommended for critical flows.
If you rely on Dedicated capacity, we recommend pinning to a stable model variant during the window: e.g. model=my-open-model:v1.2
Contact: support@redwood.ai
```

jonas: I would add a line about automatic fallback policy — "We will automatically fallback to the last healthy model variant if routing errors exceed threshold". Also include the canary hold policy (5m hold on anomaly).

alex: Rollback plan: 
- Canary for 10% of Dedicated pools for 10m. 
- Metrics to watch: failed_requests_rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency > 2x baseline -> hold. 
- On hold -> rollback to previous control-plane image and pin customer routing to model versions with explicit pin.
- Notify support + statuspage immediately.

sara: Customer-facing email draft (short): 

```
Subject: Planned maintenance — Redwood Dedicated control-plane (May 14)
Hi —
On 2026-05-14 from 02:00–03:00 UTC we will perform a rolling upgrade to the control-plane that routes Dedicated traffic. Most customers will not see disruption; some customers may experience short latency spikes. If you have critical real-time flows, consider pinning to a stable model variant during the window (see guidance below).

If we need to roll back for any reason we will update the status page and reach out via your support contact.

Guidance: to pin your routes temporarily, set model_version in the route config to the last known stable tag (e.g. my-open-model:v1.2).

Thanks,
Redwood Support
```

marie: This is great. Two quick asks: 1) Jonas please confirm the exact previous image tag for rollback (we'll include as internal only), 2) Alex please author the short runbook steps for support to execute rollback pin (one-liners).

jonas: Previous control-plane image: registry.redwood/internal/control-plane:2026-04-29-rc3. Confirmed.

alex: Support rollback runbook (one-liners): 
1) In console -> select customer -> routes -> set model_version to last-stable tag and save. 
2) If control-plane rollback required: Deploy image registry.redwood/internal/control-plane:2026-04-29-rc3 to cluster group 'dedicated-controlplane' and monitor canary for 10m. 
3) Post update to status.redwood.ai and ping #support with incident link.

sara: I'll add the statuspage and email drafts to the customer comms folder and send a preview tomorrow EOD. Also will attach a short FAQ: how to pin, how to check canary status.

marie: Perfect. Let's keep the change window but plan for a canary hold after 10m if anomalies. If no objections by EOD we'll send the customer email 48 hours before window. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: send-customer-preview cw-20260514-02 -> 2026-05-12 02:00 UTC.

jonas: No objections from eng-releases. I'll stay on-call during the window.

alex: I'll draft the quick rollback snippets for support playbook and attach to the thread.

marie: Thanks everyone — closing for now. If anything else arises, reply here.
